options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: deadinterval
options.description: Number of seconds after which a peer node is marked DOWN if heartbeat messages are not received from the peer node.

options.name: failsafe
options.description: Keep one node primary if both nodes fail the health check, so that a partially available node can back up data and handle traffic. This mode is set independently on each node.

options.name: hanode_routemonitor6_binding
options.description: Bindings for hanode_routemonitor6_binding resource

options.name: hanode_routemonitor_binding
options.description: Bindings for hanode_routemonitor_binding resource

options.name: haprop
options.description: Automatically propagate all commands from the primary to the secondary node, except the following: * All HA configuration related commands. For example, add ha node, set ha node, and bind ha node. * All Interface related commands. For example, set interface and unset interface. * All channels related commands. For example, add channel, set channel, and bind channel. The propagated command is executed on the secondary node before it is executed on the primary. If command propagation fails, or if

options.name: hastatus
options.description: The HA status of the node. The HA status C(STAYSECONDARY) is used to force the secondary device stay as secondary independent of the state of the Primary device. For example, in an existing HA setup, the Primary node has to be upgraded and this process would take few seconds. During the upgradation, it is possible that the Primary node may suffer from a downtime for a few seconds. However, the Secondary should not take over as the Primary node. Thus, the Secondary node should remain as Secondary

options.name: hasync
options.description: Automatically maintain synchronization by duplicating the configuration of the primary node on the secondary node. This setting is not propagated. Automatic synchronization requires that this setting be enabled (the default) on the current secondary node. Synchronization uses TCP port 3010.

options.name: hellointerval
options.description: Interval, in milliseconds, between heartbeat messages sent to the peer node. The heartbeat messages are UDP packets sent to port 3003 of the peer node.

options.name: id
options.description: Number that uniquely identifies the node. For self node, it will always be 0. Peer node values can range from 1-64.

options.name: inc
options.description: This option is required if the HA nodes reside on different networks. When this mode is enabled, the following independent network entities and configurations are neither propagated nor synced to the other node: MIPs, SNIPs, VLANs, routes (except LLB routes), route monitors, RNAT rules (except any RNAT rule with a VIP as the NAT IP), and dynamic routing configurations. They are maintained independently on each node.

options.name: ipaddress
options.description: The NSIP or NSIP6 address of the node to be added for an HA configuration. This setting is neither propagated nor synchronized.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: maxflips
options.description: Max number of flips allowed before becoming sticky primary

options.name: maxfliptime
options.description: Interval after which flipping of node states can again start

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: rpcnodepassword
options.description: Password to be used in authentication with the peer rpc node.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(absent), the resource will be deleted from the NetScaler ADC node. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: syncstatusstrictmode
options.description: strict mode flag for sync status

options.name: syncvlan
options.description: Vlan on which HA related communication is sent. This include sync, propagation , connection mirroring , LB persistency config sync, persistent session sync and session state sync. However HA heartbeats can go all interfaces.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
